Attribute- and relationship syntax extension:
Attributes can have postfixes in their name: [L] Language-dependant. [N] Multivalued [T] Temporal (historicised) (can appear in any combination) These attributes violate strict 1 NF and have to be resolved in the data model with detail tables. (with language, period or sequence-nr)
Relationships with [T] are temporal and have to be resolved in the data model with an period-dependent intersection entity.
